title: A worker launch that keeps failing with one reason stops relaunching and shows in master status
description: GY-3413: an item whose worker launch fails twice with the same reason, on whichever runtime the loop picks, is backed off on every runtime: no further launch (and no new epoch) until the backoff ends, and master status attention names the item, the reason and when it is tried again.

steps.name: repeated launch failures back off and reach master status attention
